paragraphs.text: So called, because this superscription, "holiness to the Lord" was graven in it.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: That is, the holiest of holies, the sanctuary and the court.
paragraphs.label: b
paragraphs.anchor: tabernacle and all that was therein

paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: To offer for the sins of the people.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: In other burnt offerings, which are not of consecration, or offering for himself, the priest has the skin, Le 7:8.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: Moses did this because the priests were not yet established in their office.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: At the door of the court.
